purpose: Predict three 30-day mean 2 m temperature targets using direct matched windows from strictly earlier calendar years.
outputs: climatology_forecast.json containing three common-schema forecast records
scientific_assumptions: training observations have calendar year strictly earlier than forecast issue year
historical windows use the current target start month/day and 30 consecutive UTC dates
a February 29 start has no equivalent in a non-leap year
verification targets are not an input
manifest_status: internal portability aid; not an official LifeWatch manifest
